task_summary: Reference architecture analysis: dinhanhthi.com uses fully static Next.js 15 + Notion API only (@notionhq/client) with GitHub Actions prebuilt deployment to Vercel on 3-day cron schedule

section_1_notion_data_layer.summary: All Notion fetching centralizes in src/lib/notion/db.ts and src/lib/fetcher.ts. Uses official @notionhq/client for database queries; uses unofficial web API for collection-based data (posts, books, tools, topics).

src/lib/notion/db.ts.description: Core Notion API wrapper with retry logic and memoization

functions.name: queryDatabaseImpl
functions.input: dbId, filter, startCursor, pageSize, sorts, notionToken, notionVersion
functions.pagination: Auto-pagination via has_more/next_cursor; recursive call with retry up to MAX_QUERY_DB_RETRIES=5; exponential backoff for 429/502/503/504/408

functions.name: getUnofficialDatabaseImpl
functions.notes: Uses unofficial Notion web API POST /queryCollection endpoint for non-DB sources (books, tools, topics); recordMap v3 normalized to v2 for compatibility

functions.name: getBlocks
functions.input: blockId, pagination support, callback getPageUri for mention resolution
functions.output: Array of BlockObjectResponse with children recursively fetched, list numbering added, bookmarks enriched with OG data
functions.block_traversal: Recursive via block.has_children flag; handles list item numbering context; fixes missing blocks via getBlocksByIds

functions.name: getPage
functions.missing_block_fix: Iterates up to 10 times calling getPageContentBlockIds to detect referenced but unfetched blocks, then getBlocksByIds to load them

functions.name: fetchOpenGraphData
functions.output: { ogTitle, ogDescription, ogImage, ogUrl, favicon } via regex (no HTML parser to avoid cheerio dependency)

src/lib/fetcher.ts.description: High-level fetching functions combining db.ts primitives with data transformation

functions.name: getPosts
functions.output: Post[] with fields: id, title, description, slug, uri, date, createdDate, tags, isDraft, pinned, blog, hide, isPublished, language, vi/en/fr (alternate slugs), notionUrl
functions.env_depends: NOTION_DB_POSTS, ENV_MODE (prod filters to published=true only)

functions.name: getUnofficialPosts
functions.output: Post[] from unofficial collection (web API queryCollection)

functions.name: getRecordMap
functions.notes: Wrapper around getPage with automatic block fixing

functions.name: getUnofficialBooks
functions.env_depends: READING_SOURCE_ID, READING_COLLECTION_VIEW_ID, READING_COVER_KEY, READING_AUTHOR_KEY, READING_DESC_KEY, READING_STAR_KEY, READING_IS_READING_KEY, READING_TAG_KEY, READING_GOODREADS_KEY, READING_KEYSEARCH_KEY, READING_READ_DATE_KEY, READING_HIDE_KEY, READING_OTHERS_KEY

functions.name: getUnofficialTools
functions.output: { tools: Tool[], tags: string[], categories: string[] }
functions.env_depends: TOOLS_SOURCE_ID, TOOLS_COLLECTION_VIEW_ID, TOOLS_ICON_KEY, TOOLS_DESC_KEY, TOOLS_SHORT_DESC_KEY, TOOLS_FREE_KEY, TOOLS_TAG_KEY, TOOLS_CATEGORY_KEY, TOOLS_URL_KEY, TOOLS_KEYSEARCH_KEY, TOOLS_HIDE_KEY, TOOLS_FAVORITE_KEY, TOOLS_MY_TOOLS_KEY

functions.name: getTopics
functions.env_depends: TOPICS_SOURCE_ID, TOPICS_COLLECTION_VIEW_ID, TOPICS_ICON_KEY, TOPICS_DESC_KEY, TOPICS_PINNED_KEY, TOPICS_HIDE_KEY, TOPICS_CLASSNAME_KEY, TOPICS_LONG_NAME_KEY

helper_utilities.date_formatting: moment.js for client; new Date().toISOString() for server; defaultPostDate = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]
helper_utilities.slugification: slugify() from 'slugify' npm package; locale: 'vi', removes [:?&".,/\\]
helper_utilities.tag_mapping: mapTag() creates Tag from NotionTagData; id/slug both use makeSlugText(name)
helper_utilities.rich_text_extraction: getJoinedRichText() joins multi-part rich_text arrays; handles plain_text from @notionhq/client responses
helper_utilities.env_filtering: getFilter() appends production filters (isPage=false, hide=false, published=true if ENV_MODE=prod)

environment_variables_build_time: NOTION_TOKEN - Bearer token for official API (v1/databases/* endpoints)
NOTION_DB_POSTS - Database ID for official posts database
NOTION_API_PUBLISHED - URL to Notion web API (default: https://www.notion.so/api/v3)
SPACE_ID - Notion space ID for unofficial API
COLLECTION_VIEW_ID - View ID for posts collection
READING_SOURCE_ID, READING_COLLECTION_VIEW_ID, READING_*_KEY - Reading list database config
TOOLS_SOURCE_ID, TOOLS_COLLECTION_VIEW_ID, TOOLS_*_KEY - Tools database config
TOPICS_SOURCE_ID, TOPICS_COLLECTION_VIEW_ID, TOPICS_*_KEY - Topics database config
NEXT_PUBLIC_ID_SLUG - Property key for slug field (likely 'slug')
NEXT_PUBLIC_ID_PUBLISHED - Property key for published field (likely 'published')

section_2_rendering_notion_blocks.summary: Custom Notion renderer in src/lib/notion/renderer.tsx and src/app/components/block.tsx. Handles 25+ block types with recursive children traversal.

src/lib/notion/renderer.tsx.description: Entry point NotionRenderer wraps recordMap in context provider

exports.name: NotionRenderer
exports.props: recordMap, components (overrides), mapPageUrl, mapImageUrl, blockOptions, useSimpleImage, postCreatedDate, postLastModifiedDate, fontClass, isImageZoomable (uses medium-zoom for img zoom)
exports.behavior: Provides NotionContextProvider wrapper with memoized medium-zoom instance; delegates to NotionBlockRenderer

exports.name: NotionBlockRenderer
exports.props: blockId, level (depth counter), recordMap from context
exports.behavior: Recursively renders Block components; walks block.content array to render children at level+1

src/app/components/block.tsx.description: Switch-case handler for all block types; ~800 lines
block_types_handled: header / sub_header / sub_sub_header (h1/h2/h3 with toggleable support, anchor generation, ToC indent)
bulleted_list / numbered_list (wraps ul/ol with li children, list item numbering context)
tweet, maps, pdf, figma, typeform, codepen, excalidraw (handled by AssetWrapper)
equation (BlockEquation with react-katex, inline or block)
code (BlockCode with react-syntax-highlighter + mermaid support for 'mermaid' language)
column_list / column (flex layout with ratio-based width)
bookmark (with OG preview: title, description, favicon, image)
src/app/components/block.tsx.rich_text_handling: Text component wraps block.properties.title/caption/description; applies annotations (bold, italic, code, strikethrough, underline, color) via CSS classes
src/app/components/block.tsx.image_handling: mapImageUrl callback transforms Notion image URLs; lazy loading via LazyImage component; SimpleImage wrapper for static images; blur data URL support
src/app/components/block.tsx.block_colors: notion-{color} CSS class applied (gray, brown, orange, yellow, green, blue, purple, pink, red); block_color from block.format
src/app/components/block.tsx.recursive_children: Children rendered via NotionBlockRenderer loop over block.content ids at level+1

block_components.purpose: Core annotation rendering (bold, italic, code, etc.)
Code block with react-syntax-highlighter + Prism; Mermaid chart detection (language='mermaid')
Alert-style blocks with icon + colored background
Unified handler for embeds, images, videos (dispatches to specialized components)
Mermaid diagram renderer (class component, calls mermaid.contentLoaded() on mount)

section_3_app_router_routes.summary: Fully static routes with generateStaticParams. Only one runtime endpoint: /api/og (Edge Function). All pages prerendered at build time.

routes.features: Home page with pinned posts, recent notes, blog posts from queryDefinitions; no API calls at runtime

routes.generation: generateStaticParams -> getUnofficialPosts -> map to { slug: post.slug }
routes.rendering: renderNotePage(slug) fetches recordMap via getRecordMap, renders SinglePostTemplate with NotionRenderer

routes.generation: generateStaticParams generates {slug: undefined} for /blogs/ and {slug: ['page', '2']}, ['page', '3'], etc.
routes.pagination: Client-side slicing by pageSize=24; no database-level pagination

routes.generation: generateStaticParams iterates getTopics(), for each tag generates {slug: [tag.slug]} and {slug: [tag.slug, 'page', '2']}, etc.

routes.features: Lists all pinned/recent notes; fetches at build time via getPosts

routes.generation: Async function returning MetadataRoute.Sitemap; includes static pages, all posts, tag pagination URLs, blog pagination URLs

api_routes.output: ImageResponse (Next.js OG image generation); 1200x630 dynamic image with gradient background

section_3_app_router_routes.runtime_config: No dynamic: 'force-dynamic' anywhere; all pages are fully static

triggers: schedule: cron '0 0 */3 * *' (every 3 days at midnight UTC)
push to main or dev branch

steps.name: Determine environment
steps.logic: If main branch: prod, else: dev

steps.name: Pull Vercel environment
steps.output: .vercel/ directory with project.json and env vars

steps.name: Deploy to Vercel
steps.notes: --prebuilt skips Vercel's build step, uses .vercel/output/ from step 10

section_4_github_actions.notion_env_vars: All Notion vars (NOTION_TOKEN, NOTION_DB_POSTS, etc.) configured in Vercel project settings > Environment Variables (not in GitHub secrets)
section_4_github_actions.caching_strategy: pnpm store + Next.js .next/cache keyed by pnpm-lock.yaml and .ts/.tsx files
section_4_github_actions.failure_handling: If build fails, GitHub sends email to repo owners; Vercel keeps previous deployment live

vercel_json.notes: Minimal config; build command NOT set (relies on GitHub Actions vercel build)

remotePatterns: gravatar.com, math2it.com, imgur.com, dinhanhthi.com, notion.so, unsplash.com, amazonaws.com, cloudinary.com
images.note: No unoptimized=true, so images are optimized by Next.js

section_5_vercel_configuration.build_on_vercel: Disabled. Build happens in GitHub Actions via 'vercel build', output deployed via 'vercel deploy --prebuilt'
section_5_vercel_configuration.env_vars_on_vercel: Production and Preview environment variables set in Vercel Settings > Environment Variables (includes all NOTION_*, READING_*, TOOLS_*, TOPICS_* vars)

section_6_pagefind_search.trigger: postbuild hook in package.json: 'npx pagefind --site .next --output-path public/pagefind'
section_6_pagefind_search.timing: After 'next build' completes, Pagefind indexes static HTML in .next/
section_6_pagefind_search.output: public/pagefind/ directory with JS index + metadata

implementation.pattern: Dynamic import at runtime: import('/pagefind/pagefind.js') via webpackIgnore: true
implementation.reason: Pagefind is generated at build time, not a real npm package

implementation.interaction: Debounced (300ms) text input -> pagefind.search(query) -> Promise.all(results.map(r => r.data())) to get metadata

implementation.ui: Command palette dialog (cmdk); shows title + excerpt snippet; URL cleaned (.html removed, index replaced)

section_6_pagefind_search.evaluation_for_math2it: Pagefind is lightweight (client-side search, no backend), works well for static sites. Requires build-time indexing. Good fit if math2it has <5000 pages.

strategy.signed S3 URLs: Pass through if already signed (X-Amz-Credential, Signature, Algorithm present)

section_7_image_pipeline.lazy_loading: LazyImage component with react-lazy-images or react-image for fallback
section_7_image_pipeline.blur_placeholder: defaultBlurDataURL (base64 webp) applied to featured images; defaultBlurData for generated images
section_7_image_pipeline.next_js_image_optimization: remotePatterns allow Notion/AWS/Unsplash/etc. but images not marked unoptimized, so Next.js optimizes on-demand via /api/_next/image endpoint
section_7_image_pipeline.caching: Vercel CDN + Next.js Image Optimization Cache (serverless function)

math_katex.inline_vs_block: Prop controls span vs. block rendering

code_highlighting.mermaid_detection: if language === 'mermaid', render Mermaid component instead of code block

mermaid.lifecycle: componentDidMount() calls mermaid.contentLoaded() to parse .mermaid divs

section_8_math_code_highlighting_mermaid.client_side_initialization: All three (KaTeX, SyntaxHighlighter, Mermaid) are client-side via 'use client'; no build-time rendering; enables dynamic themes (light/dark toggle via useTheme())

section_11_project_size_and_build_perfor.pagefind_indexing: Happens after next build; time depends on page count (typically <1 min for <1000 pages)
section_11_project_size_and_build_perfor.caching_benefits: pnpm store + .next/cache significantly speeds up subsequent builds
section_11_project_size_and_build_perfor.deployment_speed: Vercel deploy --prebuilt is fast (~1 min) since .vercel/output/ already exists

pnpm_specific.issue: dinhanhthi uses pnpm 10.20.0 with strict lockfile
pnpm_specific.for_yarn4: math2it uses yarn 4. Key differences: pnpm layout is stricter (node_modules/.pnpm), yarn is flatter. When adapting: Verify peer deps resolve identically, test node_modules structure

next_15_specific_features.issue: Uses Next.js 15.5.15 features: React 19 (actions, useFormStatus, etc.)
next_15_specific_features.math2it_on_14: Next.js 14 lacks some optimizations. When backporting: Avoid 'use server' directives if using 14, use getServerSideProps instead for server data

react_19_specific.issue: React 19 has no propTypes, different hooks
react_19_specific.for_react_18: math2it on React 18 should work, but hooks like useFormStatus won't exist; use useTransition instead

unofficial_notion_api_dependency.issue: dinhanhthi relies heavily on unofficial Notion web API (queryCollection, loadPageChunk) for books/tools/topics
unofficial_notion_api_dependency.risk: Unofficial API can break with Notion updates; no support
unofficial_notion_api_dependency.mitigation: If math2it uses only official @notionhq/client, avoid unofficial API. dinhanhthi's approach is deliberate to fetch large collections cheaply.

notion_api_v3_normalization.issue: db.ts normalizeRecordMap() handles v2 vs v3 format. Current Notion API returns v3.
notion_api_v3_normalization.for_math2it: Ensure NOTION_VERSION env var is recent (2024-10+). Older versions may not support all properties.

hardcoded_giscus_config.issue: Comments.tsx hardcodes dinhanhthi's GitHub repo + category IDs
hardcoded_giscus_config.for_math2it: If adding Giscus, parameterize repo/categoryId via env vars or config file

staticPageGenerationTimeout_600s.issue: next.config sets timeout to 600s (10 min). If math2it has many posts/slow Notion API, may need increase.
staticPageGenerationTimeout_600s.monitoring: Watch GitHub Actions logs for 'Execution timed out' errors

image_optimization_on_demand.issue: Next.js Image Optimization (remotePatterns) runs on-demand, not at build time
image_optimization_on_demand.for_static_first: Images are optimized on first request to Vercel. No pre-caching. For 100% static, consider pre-optimizing via next/image static export.

recommendations_for_math2it.1_adopt_unofficial_api_carefully: dinhanhthi uses unofficial API for posts (not just books). Only switch to it if math2it has large post counts or complex filtering. Start with official @notionhq/client.
recommendations_for_math2it.2_yarn_4_migration: dinhanhthi uses pnpm; math2it uses yarn 4. Ensure dependency resolution is identical; test node_modules structure.
recommendations_for_math2it.3_env_var_strategy: Follow dinhanhthi's Vercel environment variables approach: store all Notion secrets in Vercel Settings, not GitHub. This is safer.
recommendations_for_math2it.4_pagefind_evaluation: If math2it has <5000 pages, Pagefind is good. If >10K pages, test build time impact.
recommendations_for_math2it.5_github_actions_cron_adaptation: Reuse dinhanhthi's deploy-vercel.yml structure. Adapt pnpm -> yarn, adjust cron if math2it's content changes less frequently.
recommendations_for_math2it.6_next_14_compatibility: dinhanhthi targets Next.js 15. If math2it stays on 14, avoid React 19-only features; backport carefully.
recommendations_for_math2it.7_image_pipeline_testing: Test image rendering with Notion's current API. dinhanhthi handles both signed and unsigned URLs; ensure math2it covers all Notion image sources.
recommendations_for_math2it.8_comments_parameterization: If using Giscus, parameterize repo/category IDs via environment variables instead of hardcoding.
